description:
Audit a page's canonical link integrity: presence, self-reference, cross-domain mismatches, trailing-slash hygiene, and og:url consistency.

Read-only. One HTTP GET to fetch the HEAD section.

Deterministic, rule-based; no LLM.

When to use: a focused canonical-only audit (e.g. debugging a duplicate-content issue). For a full HEAD audit including OpenGraph, hreflang, noindex, title, use `check_technical`. For everything-on-a-page, use `audit_page`.

respect_robots.description: If true (default), respect robots.txt before fetching. Set false only for auditing your own site where you've intentionally blocked crawlers.

url.description: Public URL whose canonical link tag and og:url consistency you want to audit. Must be a fully-qualified http(s) URL. The tool fetches the URL (following redirects) and inspects only the <head> section; the body is not parsed.

name: audit_canonical

cross_domain.description: Whether the canonical points to a different domain.

category.description: Finding category - which AI-SEO dimension it relates to.

estimated_impact.description: Estimated impact on AI citation probability when resolved.

failure_signal.description: Falsifiability: the observable signal that would prove the fix did NOT work.

leading_indicator.description: Falsifiability: the leading indicator to monitor to confirm the fix is landing.

severity.description: Triage priority: critical blocks AI citation, warning hurts probability, info is nice-to-have.

where.description: Location of the issue (CSS selector, JSON-LD path, robots.txt line, or 'page-level').

self_referencing.description: Whether the canonical points to the audited URL.

title: Audit canonical link integrity
